result.prompt: A photorealistic studio product photograph of a single matte black stainless-steel water bottle, standing upright and large in the center of a vertical 4:5 frame, its entire silhouette visible with generous space above the cap and a narrow margin below the base. The bottle has a clean cylindrical body, gently rounded shoulders, a short neck, and a neatly fitted screw cap in matching matte black, with a fine horizontal seam beneath the lid; no handle, graphics, lettering, or branding. Its proportions remain straight and symmetrical, viewed from a camera positioned at mid-bottle height with a very slight downward angle revealing the cap’s top surface. A broad, diffused softbox from upper camera left creates a restrained charcoal-gray highlight along the left shoulder and body, revealing the finely textured powder-coated finish without glossy reflections. Subtle frontal fill preserves detail on the darker right edge. The bottle rests on a smooth neutral medium-gray studio surface against a seamless gray backdrop, with a soft, short shadow extending toward the lower right. The palette is limited to deep black, graphite, and neutral gray. Crisp product detail, realistic material texture, controlled contrast, and a quiet, premium commercial photography aesthetic.
